title: Handbook Extraction Engine
brief: Build HandbookExtractionEngine that parses raw handbook content (PDF text, OCR output, structured tables) into typed section records. Includes section boundary detection, table parsing, unit normalization, and confidence scoring per extracted field.

units.title: Implement section boundary detector: classify raw text blocks into one of 10 handbook section types using keyword patterns and structural heuristics
Implement table parser: extract specification tables (spindle speed ranges, axis travel limits, tool capacity) into typed key-value records with unit detection
Implement unit normalizer and confidence scorer: convert imperial/metric values to canonical units, assign confidence (0-1) per extracted field based on extraction method and source quality
Build extraction test suite with real handbook samples: validate against known Haas VF-2, Mazak QTN-200, and DMG MORI NLX-2500 specification pages

exit_conditions: HandbookExtractionEngine extracts at least 8 of 10 section types from sample handbooks
Table parser correctly extracts numeric spec values with >90% accuracy on test samples
All extracted values carry confidence scores and canonical units
Extraction test suite passes with 0 failures against 3 manufacturer sample sets
